description.description: A brief description of the ruleset.
description.example: A ruleset designed to enforce security standards for APIs.

rulesetContent.description: The content of the ruleset file (YAML or JSON).
rulesetContent.example:
rules:
  oas2-always-use-https:
    given:
      - '$.schemes[*]'
    severity: error
    then:
      function: enumeration
      functionOptions:
        values:
          - https
    description: >-
      Host schemes must use the HTTPS protocol. Applies to: OpenAPI 2.0`
    message: API host schemes must use the HTTPS protocol.
    formats:
      - oas2

ruleCategory.description: Category the rules included in ruleset.

ruleType.description: Context or area to which the ruleset applies.

artifactType.description: The type of artifact that the ruleset validates.

documentationLink.description: URL to the documentation related to the ruleset.

provider.description: Entity or individual providing the ruleset.
